items.title: Santo Pecora Interview, 1972-11-09
items.q: first movie I made with Bing Crosby, rhythm on the river

ctx.x: I gave it up. I had to quit. Yeah. What about playing a silent movie? What would that be like? Would you have to read much to do that? Oh. What a new movie would come up like? How would you play it? How did you know what to do?

Well, I never did play silent. Oh, you never did? No. I never did. I played... The only thing I played... around 1936 when I... first movie I made with Bing Crosby, rhythm on the river. You know, where they can see you and they can hear you play.
Oh, you were in that? With Wingy? Yeah.
